verdict: PASS for deterministic historical simulation under the disclosed assumptions; no unresolved Blocker or Major finding. Provider-adjusted equivalence and strict point-in-time data vintage are not certified.

findings.title: Engine did not independently reject unverified missing bars
findings.evidence: Initial version relied on normalizer coverage checks. Final validate_input rejects missing dates outside metadata.verified_suspensions and exactly matches start/end bounds; test_unverified_missing_bar_is_an_error passes. Current actual data had no unexplained gaps at any point.

findings.title: One-price-day rejection must not imply a lower-bound return
findings.evidence: Report now calls high=low rejection an ex-post daily-bar execution availability approximation, retains observed close for valuation and disclaims a performance lower bound. Independent sensitivity finds main-scenario 50% threshold ending NAV increases 42410.39539251849 TWD versus assumed opening fills, with CAGR increasing 0.0004488202888863757. The caveat and rounded differences appear in report source.

findings.title: Sortino prose placed annualization beside the denominator ambiguously
findings.evidence: Report source now states daily mean excess return divided by the all-observation negative-excess RMS, multiplied by sqrt(252), with nonnegative days contributing zero. Engine formula and synthetic test were correct.

checks.evidence: python3 -m unittest -v test_backtest.py completed successfully. Synthetic tests cover fees, exact post-cost targets, threshold next-open timing, corporate actions, suspension, one-price marks/fills, dividend entitlement/payment/reinvestment, calendar interest, metric definitions, censored recovery and deterministic outputs.

checks.method: Independent execution uses numerical bisection rather than the engine closed-form target equation. Cash accrual uses session gaps and intervening payment events rather than a calendar-day loop. All 24 complete paths, trade dates, CAGR, MDD, Sharpe, Sortino and longest recovery compare successfully. Saved metrics/configuration/NAV files and engine/input manifest hashes match fresh engine runs.

checks.evidence: Re-ran normalizer in an isolated work directory using copied raw snapshots. Core start/end/calendar/prices/splits/dividends identical; original output data and original project were not modified by that check.

All 2907 and 2908 normalized price rows equal saved market-provider raw records; recorded raw hashes match. Independent parsing of six saved TWSE stock-month responses matches 48 rows / 192 OHLC fields. Both official split PDF snapshots are saved and referenced by hashed spotcheck manifest.

Multiplying future prices after 2022-12-30 by 1.19 leaves all prior daily account values and trades identical for all eight strategies. Threshold tests prove next-open execution. This is a signal/accounting test, not proof of historical publication/vintage availability or actual order fills.

limitations.description: Current retrospective snapshots lack proven historical vintages and all corporate-action publication timestamps. Unknown announcement times remain null. No strict point-in-time claim is endorsed.

Fractional units, fixed slippage, raw opening reference prices and one-price-bar fill rejection are execution-model assumptions; daily OHLC cannot prove personal order priority, available liquidity or actual fill. One-price rejection is an ex-post execution approximation and can improve returns.

Cash 0/1/2% yields are hypothetical effective annual rates, not observed historical deposit returns. Trade-date cash bookkeeping omits T+2 settlement restrictions; personal taxes and minimum brokerage fees are excluded.
Verified suspensions are not executable. Last observed close is retained only for valuation, so daily risk measures are affected by stale marks and subsequent catch-up price changes.
Six official stock-month samples and all official 0050 dividend events were cross-checked, but not every historical daily price independently verified against TWSE.

reproduce.notes: Independent checker exits nonzero on a failed check; it reads original snapshots/results and rewrites only its own validation evidence files.
